author: Inside Edition
description: Several dozen World War 2-era bomb shelters have been converted into cooling centers in Chongqing, China. The shelters' original purpose was to provide some protection to the people of Chongqing during the later 1930s and early 1940s, when the industrial region was devastated by Japanese bombing raids. Now, Chongqing faces a different threat: devastating heat, with summer temperatures in the southwestern Chinese city reaching over a hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
title: Old Bomb Shelters Are Repurposed As Cooling Centers

author: Inside Edition
description: A friendly neighborhood Spider-Man came to the rescue when a man tried to cross a busy highway in his wheelchair. The costumed hero hopped out of his car and sprinted across the street with the man. After his good deed, he dodged traffic on the way back to his car. Inside Edition tracked down the cosplaying hero, and he revealed his secret identity. Christopher Hellenthal lives in Jonesboro, Arkansas.
title: Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Helps Man In Wheelchair Cross Highway

author: Inside Edition
description: Details of high school mass shooter Colt Gray's plan have been revealed for the first time. Gray was 14 years old when he gunned down two fellow students and two math teachers at Apalachee High School in Georgia in 2024. Gray's father, Colin, gave his son the rifle as a Christmas present. Colin became the first parent in the state to be charged and convicted in connection with a mass shooting tied to their child. He was convicted of murder and manslaughter and will be sentenced next week.
title: Investigators Reveal Colt Gray's Plan To Carry Out Georgia High School Shooting

author: Inside Edition
description: Bodycam video has been released of a Secret Service agent in handcuffs with his pants hanging open. He was arrested at a Miami hotel. Police were called by female hotel guests who say the agent exposed himself and followed them to their room. Agent John Spillman has been charged with indecent exposure. He was in Miami to protect President Trump at a PGA tournament. Spillman, who is based in Washington DC, has pleaded not guilty and has been placed on administrative leave.
title: Secret Service Agent Arrested After Allegedly Exposing Himself To Hotel Guests

author: Inside Edition
description: Lindsay Clancy is accused of strangling her three children three years ago, after which she jumped from a second-floor window. The leap left her paralyzed for life. A Massachusetts jury has been seated in what is expected to be one of the most heart-wrenching murder trials in recent history. Her lawyers claim she was suffering from postpartum depression and postpartum psychosis when she strangled her young children. Prosecutors argue she was clear-thinking and planned to murder her children.
title: Jury Seated For Lindsay Clancy's Murder Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Strangers banded together to rescue three women trapped inside a car that flew off an overpass and landed on its roof. The good Samaritans grabbed what they could as they raced to free the young women. It is not known what caused the accident. The injured women were taken to the hospital, and they are all expected to survive.
title: Strangers Band Together To Rescue Women Trapped Inside Car

author: Inside Edition
description: If there's one thing that can put a damper on summer fun, it's mosquitos. Experts say they're showing up sooner than usual. That's concerning because the leading cause of disease spread by mosquitos, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, is West Nile virus. Alex Inghilterra of Colorado contracted the disease last year. She tells CBS News that she was diagnosed with meningitis, a life threatening condition. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: West Nile Virus Makes Earlier Appearance Due To Climate Change

author: Inside Edition
description: This highway accident didn't cause any major injuries, unless you're a lover of corn. Then you're probably mourning the loss of a truck full of the crop. Authorities in Washington state say the truck tipped over ,snarling traffic in the  morning and part of the afternoon. The cleanup took hours with officials giving updates  throughout the day. Aside from the semi, the sheer amount of corn completely blocked the roadway. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Traffic Halted After Truckload Of Corn Spills All Over Road
